description:
Read the matching Cactal skill before acting: source-editing-workflow before source edits, design-direction for design, copywriting for words. Required skills are included.

- analytics: Traffic, visitors, referrers, and other analytics reports
- assets-and-media: Generate, import, or place images, video, fonts, favicons
- cms-content-editing: Create, edit, publish, schedule, or delete CMS items
- cms-data-in-pages: Show CMS content on pages with definePage queries
- cms-item-queries: Filter, search, and sort CMS item lists
- cms-modeling: Create or change CMS collections and fields
- copywriting: Write or rewrite website copy
- design-direction: New visual design or restyling of palette, type, and layout
- forms: Forms, submissions, and notification recipients
- image-reforming: Turn found or imperfect photos into better images
- imports-and-modules: Imports, components, and shared modules
- logo-design: Design or redraw a logo, brand mark, icon, or favicon
- npm-packages: Add, upgrade, or debug npm packages
- page-metadata-and-seo: Page metadata, SEO, social cards, and sitemaps
- pages-and-routes: Create pages, routes, URL params, and a custom 404
- publishing-and-recovery: Publish, roll back, restore, or unpublish the website
- rendering-and-browser-apis: Browser-only APIs, Intl, and server render failures
- server-functions: Server functions and website secrets
- shaders: Build GPU effects with Paper Shaders or custom GLSL
- source-editing-workflow: Read before any page, component, CSS, or config edit
- source-files-and-naming: Create, delete, or name source files
- styling-and-css: Global CSS, Tailwind theme, and fonts
- validate-and-preview: Checks, diagnostics, screenshots, and deployments
- web-research: Public web facts and studying reference sites
- website-config: Redirects, response headers, and website_config
- website-settings-and-domains: Rename the website or slug, hosts, custom domains, DNS

skillId.description: Skill to read; the skills it requires come with it.

name: skills_read
title: Read a Cactal agent skill
